Stock Yards Bank & Trust Co. lowered its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 1.4% in the third quarter, according to the company in its most recent disclosure with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The institutional investor owned 165,717 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 2,347 shares during the period. Apple accounts for 3.0% of Stock Yards Bank & Trust Co.’s portfolio, making the stock its 3rd largest position. Stock Yards Bank & Trust Co.’s holdings in Apple were worth $25,540,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).

Shares of Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ:AAPL ) opened at $173.03 on Friday. The company has a current ratio of 1.28, a quick ratio of 1.23 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.73. Apple Inc. has a twelve month low of $115.81 and a twelve month high of $177.20. The company has a market cap of $888,390.00, a price-to-earnings ratio of 18.83, a P/E/G ratio of 1.41 and a beta of 1.23. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, November 2nd. The iPhone maker reported $2.07 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, beating the consensus estimate of $1.87 by $0.20. Apple had a net margin of 21.09% and a return on equity of 36.29%. The firm had revenue of $52.58 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $50.71 billion. During the same period in the previous year, the business earned $1.50 EPS. The company’s revenue was up 12.2% compared to the same quarter last year. analysts predict that Apple Inc. will post 11.18 EPS for the current year.

About Apple 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
